english.title: Road accident - fail to report and produce insurance - mechanically propelled vehicle
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a mechanically propelled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), owing to the presence of which on a road, or other public place, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD OR PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..) an accident occurred whereby personal injury was caused to another person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), and, not then having produced such a certificate of insurance or other evidence as is mentioned in section 165(2) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 to

(A)_[a constable,]_
(B)_[some person, who having reasonable grounds for doing so, required you to produce it,]_

failed to comply with a duty to report the accident and produce such a certificate or other evidence at a police station or to a constable as soon as was reasonably practicable and, in any case, within twenty-four hours of the occurrence of the accident
english.legislation: Contrary to section 170(7) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See section 170(7), and accompanying 'Notes', for exception where HORT /1 is issued.
(ii) Until 1st November 2021, securities or deposits could be used as an alternative to conventional motor insurance. For offences before that date see H3131.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) which had been involved in an accident on **(..SPECIFY ROAD OR PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..). As a result of the accident, injury was caused to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..).

The defendant

(A)_[failed to report the accident and]_
(B)_[reported the accident but failed to]_

produce evidence of insurance to the police within the appropriate period.
